compiledRowFingerprintMethod: SHA-256 of UTF-8 byte-sorted JSON row keys joined by newline, without a terminal newline. Keys preserve literal name and position, convert pay and non-null expense to integer cents, and preserve null expense and duplicate multiplicity. Verified against the immutable compiled snapshot and the pre-pass employer exports.
